column1: # The SFZ reference's opcodes (sfz.github.io data/sfz/syntax.yml, CC0), one per
# line: its name (N, X, Y: a number), version, category, what it is an alias of,
# and how odawg reads it: plays (it sounds as SFZ says), compile (read once at
# compile: a CC at its value), info (doesn't change the sound), warn (not played:
# a warning naming it). The *_dynamic opcodes are info: they compute an envelope
# (or an EQ) again when a CC moves, and an instrument's CCs are set at compile,
# never moved while a note plays.
